api:
OV.BattleUI.model, new pure functions:
- lineRisk(B, shooter, tx, ty, tz, {seen?, exclude?}) → [{id, d, t}]. Returns allied soldiers and civilians that are seen and within 1 tile of the shooter→target line. Only those in front of the shooter count, up to 2 tiles past the target and within 1 level. Sorted nearest to the shooter first.
- lineConfirm(settings, difficulty, pct) → bool. Decides whether a second click is required.
  - 'auto' = Recruta and a hit chance below 50 %.
  - 'always' and 'never' follow settings.confirmBlast.
- logEntry(B, ev, ctx) now also handles 'shot' events from our own soldiers:
  - One log entry per shot or burst. The same entry is updated as the damage events arrive.
  - Keys: hud.log.shot.{miss, missTile, burstMiss, burstMissTile, hit, burstHit, noDmg, hitMany}.
  - kind is 'good' (✔) or 'miss' (○). own = true during the alien turn (reaction fire).

OV.BattleUI.debug.state():
- target gains risk:[unitId], toI and lock.
- New fields unitTag {unitId, text} and tapLock.

Battlescape behaviour:
- Clicking an alien button (.bs-alien) while aiming or throwing makes that alien the target (S.pin). The 1st click/tap previews the shot and arms the confirmation; the 2nd fires.
- Pressing 1–0, an alien button or kbJumpAlien shows a name tag over the alien for 2.6 s.
- Reserve buttons and toggle buttons (kneel, map) get aria-pressed. .bs-reserve has role=group plus an aria-label. The .on state also shows a ✓ badge.

OV.BattleRender:
- pick(view, px, py, B?, {hostileFirst, tol}?): while aiming, a visible hostile's box wins over any unit drawn in front of it, with tol px of slack.
- New pickHostile(rects, px, py, tol).
- view.target.risk = [unitId] draws a dashed ring plus a «!» triangle on those soldiers.
- view.unitTag = {unitId, text} draws a label above that unit.
- Aliens seen by X-COM on undiscovered tiles are now drawn. They also get a ghost (alpha 0.6) and the diamond on top of walls.

OV.FX:
- New field palette ('normal'|'cvd'). In 'cvd', damage numbers are white with a dark outline.
- reduceMotion = true: damage numbers do not rise and stay 1.8 s.
- Damage numbers now read «−n».

OV.Presenter: when none of our burst hits the target alien, a «falhou» floating text appears over the target (hud.fx.miss). Explosive ammo is excluded.

OV.Input:
- New pure I.pinchStep(state, d, mx, my) → {zoom:{factor, scale}|null, pan:{cx, cy}|null}. Zoom only starts after 2 consecutive frames past PINCH_DEAD; scale is absolute for the gesture.
- 'zoom' events from a pinch now carry gid and scale. battle_ui applies zoom0·scale.
- The first finger of a new gesture (isPrimary) clears stale touches. lostpointercapture removes the finger.

OV.InventoryUI.model.navPick(rects, k, dir) → index (k = stay put). Arrows only go to boxes entirely past the current box's edge. ←/→ stay on the same row or within a narrow cone.

Equip and combat inventory picker on touch: holding 300 ms (HOLD_MS) lifts the item. touchmove is then cancelled (non-passive listener), so the list does not scroll. A quick vertical drag still scrolls. Releasing in place leaves the item selected. Store-row ghosts are capped at 260 px and centred on the finger.

New pt-PT keys in pt-PT.hud.js:
- hud.target.nearLine.{one,other}
- hud.confirmLine.{click,tap,key}.{one,other}
- hud.log.shot.{miss,missTile,burstMiss,burstMissTile,hit,burstHit,noDmg,hitMany}
- hud.log.unseenAlien, hud.fx.miss, hud.tip.alienAim(.touch), hud.reserve.group

Changed keys: hud.inv.hint.touch and hud.equip.hint.touch now say «mantenha o dedo nele um instante e arraste-o».
summary:
All 8 round-4 battle/inventory findings are fixed in my files. The Geoscape half of #4 and the hint wording in base/campaign need patches in files I don't own (open_issues). `node tools/test.js --strict --i18n` passes 779/779; the new Node test `tools/tests/ui_persona_r4.test.js` has 7 tests. One run during the QA load failed only `battle_ai`'s ≤ 20 ms/action timing check (21.7 ms); it passes on a quiet CPU.

QA, all exit 0:
- New `qa/persona_r4_battle.mjs`: 39/39.
- `persona_r3_battle`, `persona_r2_battle`, `inventory_check`, `ux_regress`, `battle_play`, `full_battle`, `integration_r3`.
- `persona_r1_battle`: its keyboard path to the Equip stores relied on the old diagonal arrow jumps; I adjusted that path (go up first; ↓ from the top buttons).
- `full_campaign` once: no errors, 0 confusing moments.

Screenshots, all looked at, are in `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/ui4/persona_r4/`. They cover 1440×900, 1024×576 at 125 %, iPad 1194×834 and 834×1194, and 1024×560 for the inventory.

Per finding:
- **#1 Tiago, friendly fire near the line (major) — fixed.**
  - Root cause: `previewTarget` only warned when an ally blocked the line exactly.
  - New `lineRisk` flags seen allies and civilians within 1 tile of the shooter→target line: in front of the shooter and up to 2 tiles past the target.
  - The label shows «Risco: Julia Richter está perto da linha de tiro» or «Risco: n aliados…». Those soldiers get a red dashed ring and a «!» triangle (shape, not just colour).
  - On Recruta with a hit chance under 50 %, the first click asks «Clique outra vez — pode atingir {nome}». This reuses the explosives confirmation, including the double-click and 400 ms guards. Veterano shows only the warning.
  - Regression check: Node test + QA A, at 1440 and 1024×576.
- **#2 Pedro, inventory arrows (Ainda presente) — fixed at the root.**
  - Navigation is now a pure `navPick`: a candidate must lie entirely past the current box's edge.
  - ← from the empty left hand stays put. ↓ goes to the belt, never to the right hand. ↑ from the belt returns to the left hand.
  - Regression check: Node test with the persona's geometry + QA B at 1024×560, DSF 2.5.
- **#3 Pedro, hit/miss not logged — fixed.**
  - One log line per shot or burst: «Catarina acertou em Sectoide (−12)», «acertou 2 de 3 … (−18)», «falhou o tiro em …», «a armadura aguentou».
  - Reaction fire in the alien turn also goes into the turn report.
  - A «falhou» text floats over the target when nothing hit.
  - Damage numbers read «−n». In the cvd palette they are white with a dark outline; with reduced motion they stay still for 1.8 s.
  - Regression check: Node test + QA A (N panel).
- **#4 Pedro, reserve state shown only by colour — fixed in the Battlescape.**
  - aria-pressed on the reserve, kneel and map buttons. The reserve group has an aria-label.
  - A ✓ badge shows on the active button (white in cvd).
  - The Geoscape radiogroup already has its aria-label; the roving tabindex is in geo_ui.js (open_issues).
  - Regression check: QA D.
- **#5 Pedro, alien hidden behind the wall — fixed at the root.**
  - The renderer skipped aliens seen by X-COM whose tile (or the anchor tile of a 2×2) was still undiscovered: that is why only the HUD said «1».
  - Such aliens are now drawn, with a 0.6 ghost and the hostile diamond on top of walls.
  - Pressing 1–0, clicking the alien button or using the keyboard jump shows a name tag.
  - Regression check: QA C, cvd palette, 1440 and 1024×576.
- **#6 Marta, can't tap an alien right behind the soldier (major) — fixed.**
  - While aiming or throwing, `pick` prefers a visible hostile's box, with 20 px slack on touch and 4 px with a mouse.
  - Tapping an alien button while aiming targets it: the 1st tap previews and arms, the 2nd fires.
  - Regression check: Node test + QA E on iPad landscape and portrait.
- **#7 Marta, Equip drag in portrait only scrolls — fixed.**
  - A 300 ms long press lifts the item. touchmove is then cancelled, so the list stops scrolling.
  - A quick vertical swipe still scrolls the list. The touch hints in my i18n file now mention the long press.
  - Regression check: QA F on iPad portrait.
- **#8 Marta, zoom drops during two-finger pans (Ainda presente) — fixed at the root.**
  - I reproduced it: 3 of 14 runs dropped to 1.5. Chrome sometimes delivers one finger's sample a frame late, so the distance briefly jumps 80→95→80. That gave a zoom of 1.19 (cut off at the maximum) followed by 0.84.
  - Zoom now only starts after 2 consecutive frames over the threshold, and pinch zoom is absolute per gesture (zoom0·scale).
  - Stale touches are cleared at the start of each gesture and on lost capture.
  - After the fix: 0/14 runs dropped, and QA G held zoom 2 over 16 pans.
deviations: Arrow navigation is stricter: only boxes entirely past the current edge count. From the full-width info panel at the bottom of Equip, → no longer jumps up-right to the stores; you press ↑ first. qa/persona_r1_battle.mjs had relied on the old diagonal jumps for its keyboard path and was adjusted to go up first.

The near-line warning also shows outside Recruta and above 50 % hit chance, as a warning only. The second click is required only on Recruta with a hit chance under 50 %, and Options «Confirmar explosivos» 'Sempre'/'Nunca' applies to it too. I added no new option.
Damage floaters now read «−n» instead of «n», in every palette.
Aliens on undiscovered tiles are drawn in the renderer. The sim still does not mark the tiles of visible enemies as discovered (see open_issues).
open_issues: Finding #7, touch hints in other owners' i18n files. Change pt-PT.base.js 'base.equip.hint.touch' to «Toque no objeto e depois no destino, ou mantenha o dedo nele um instante e arraste-o.» Change pt-PT.campaign.js 'cp.eq.hint.touch' to «Toque num objeto e depois no destino, ou mantenha o dedo nele e arraste-o · toque num soldado para mudar · «Concluído» guarda». The long-press drag works in both screens; only the wording differs.

Finding #5, sim side (optional, js/sim/battle/los.js): the renderer now draws aliens that X-COM sees on undiscovered tiles. The root inconsistency remains: OV.LOS adds an enemy to B._.visible.xcom without setting map.disc |= 1 on that enemy's tiles (Terror site, alien behind a window; 2×2 units only partly in view). Marking each visible enemy's unitTiles as discovered in the visibility pass would also reveal the floor under them.

Finding #1, optional extra the persona suggested (js/ui/screens.js, debrief owner): when the mission log has a friendly-fire death, show a tip such as «Não dispares por cima dos teus soldados — afasta-os da linha». The Battlescape already shows the warning before the shot.

tools/tests/battle_ai.test.js «≤ 20 ms por ação alienígena» failed once (21.7 ms) while 3 Chromium QA runs were loading the 4 shared CPUs. It passes on a quiet CPU; it is a timing check that is sensitive to load, not a regression.
